## Intro
On this page, you can find categorized examples of API usage for the Teslasuit SDK. Each example demonstrates how to interact with a specific subsystem or feature of the Teslasuit.

## Examples

### Sensor Data
- [PPG](ppg_example.qmd): Retrieve heart rate and HRV data.
- [EMG (experimental)](emg_example.qmd): Stream muscle activity data.
- [BIA (experimental)](bia_example.qmd): Analyze body composition using impedance data.

### Motion Capture
- [Mocap](mocap_example.qmd): Stream biomechanical angles and IMU data.

### Feedback Systems
- [Force Feedback (Teslaglove)](force_feedback_example.qmd): Configure and control force feedback.
- [Haptic](haptic_example.qmd): Create and play haptic feedback.

### Current Monitoring
- [Current Feedback (experimental)](current_feedback_example.qmd): Stream current feedback data from nodes and channels.
